# Capture and protocol components

These source files are from cyberbadger6969/aion2-dps-meter,
commit 414de5c1d5f3d45ce35701bd25229c2dba736bb6:
https://github.com/cyberbadger6969/aion2-dps-meter

License: GPL-3.0. The complete upstream license is in LICENSE.
Capture, event contracts, GameData and protocol readers are reused;
the original meter UI, combat ranking, recorder, update client, demo,
online assets and game catalogues are not incorporated.

The protocol is experimental in Strigoi. South America has not been
validated. This does not imply endorsement by the upstream authors.
Local changes are documented in CHANGES.md.
